theorem sub3 {pp : P} (hF : 16 ≤ (lay pp .stk).len) (y : Y) : (ρ3 pp y).Sub (lay pp (proj y)) := by
  rcases y with _ | r
  · exact Split.sub_none hF
  · exact Split.sub_some r

theorem posG {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) (y : Y) :
    0 < (ρ3 pp y).len ∨ (ρ3 pp y).base < heapStart ∨ heapEnd ≤ (ρ3 pp y).base := by
  have := hP.res.apos{BP2}
  rcases y with _ | r
  · left; simp [ρ3, Split.lay]
  · cases r <;> (left; simp [ρ3, Split.lay, lay, textIv, textLen]; try omega)

/-- The heap checkpoint at the entry. -/
theorem entry_hp {pp : P} {mm : Mem} {rr : BitVec 64} (hP : GPre pp mm rr) :
    HP (ρX pp) wX (Api.{API}.hin pp) (Api.{API}.hin pp) (InAny (lay pp) Api.{API}.ws) mm mm := by
  have hF : 16 ≤ (lay pp .stk).len := by simp only [lay]; omega
  have hstk : Ram (lay pp .stk).base (lay pp .stk).len := (hP.bund .stk).2
  refine HP.entry hP.heap (fun y => (hP.off (proj y)).sub (sub3 hF y) (posG hP y)) ?_ ?_
  · intro y hy q hq
    have hs := sub3 hF y
    have hq2 : (ρ3 pp y).In q := hq
    have hq' : (lay pp (proj y)).In q := by unfold Iv.Sub Iv.In at *; omega
    rcases y with _ | r
    · exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.{API}.R.stk) (by decide) hq'
    · cases r <;> simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.{API}.R.stk) (by decide) hq'
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.{API}.R.bS) (by decide) hq'
      · exact InAny.of_mem (w := Api.{API}.R.bD) (by decide) hq'
  · intro y hy
    have hs := sub3 hF y
    rcases y with _ | r
    · exact Ram.sub hstk hs.1 hs.2
    · cases r <;> simp [wX, w3, Split.wr, isW] at hy
      · exact Ram.sub hstk hs.1 hs.2
      · simpa [ρ3, Split.lay, lay, Layout.sizeofMpInt] using (Hdr.geom (show Hdr mm pp.pb pp.bdp pp.b from (hP.bund .bS).2)).st
      · simpa [ρ3, Split.lay, lay] using (show Dig mm pp.bdp pp.b.alloc pp.b.digit from (hP.bund .bD).2).ram
